description.value: Machi Sushi is a compact neighbourhood Japanese restaurant on Cadboro Bay Road in Oak Bay, serving an extensive menu of creative specialty rolls, sashimi, nigiri, and donburi bowls with a focus on fresh and locally sourced ingredients. The chef's signature rolls — including the Vancouver Roll and Caterpillar Roll — have earned consistent praise from local diners. Dine-in, takeout, and online ordering are all available.

address.value: 2583 Cadboro Bay Rd, Victoria, BC V8R 5J1

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 24m; rack at 29m; rack (6 spaces) at 36m; rack (4 spaces) at 47m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website at machisushi.ca confirms the business is an active dine-in and takeout Japanese sushi restaurant. Phone number and street address on the website match OSM values, but the OSM website tag (machisushivictoria.com) differs from the discovered URL (machisushi.ca), and OSM opening hours are substantially different from those shown on the website. A customer review explicitly states 'Bathroom was clean,' confirming washroom access; neither the website nor OSM mentions any bike parking infrastructure or visibility.
concerns: OSM website tag 'www.machisushivictoria.com/' does not match the operating website 'https://machisushi.ca' — the OSM tag should be updated.

OSM opening_hours include lunch service (11:30–14:30) and later evening closing times, which contradicts the website's consistent listing of Mon–Sat 4:30pm–8:30pm, Sunday closed — OSM hours appear substantially outdated.
OSM addr:city is 'Oak Bay'; website consistently lists 'Victoria, BC' — Oak Bay is a legally distinct municipality, though commonly grouped with Victoria.
OSM fax tag value (+1-778-406-1888) is identical to the phone number, which is likely a data entry error in OSM.
